# Provenance

`parser.c` and `parser.h` in this directory are vendored, unmodified except
for one `#include` path rewrite (`tree_sitter/parser.h` -> `parser.h`, to
match how every per-language package in `github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter`
lays out its own local copy of the header), from:

- Source: https://github.com/amaanq/tree-sitter-objc (now maintained at
  https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-objc)
- File: `src/parser.c`, `src/tree_sitter/parser.h`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Fetched: 2026-09-19, from the `master` branch HEAD at fetch time.
- `parser.c` is machine-generated by the tree-sitter CLI from that project's
  `grammar.js`; it is not hand-written and should not be hand-edited. To
  update the grammar, re-fetch `src/parser.c` (and `src/tree_sitter/parser.h`
  if it has changed) from the upstream repo, re-apply the same `#include`
  rewrite, and re-run astkit's test suite.
- Grammar ABI: `LANGUAGE_VERSION 14`, matching
  `TREE_SITTER_LANGUAGE_VERSION` in the vendored
  `github.com/smacker/go-tree-sitter` core (`api.h`) — compatible without
  a runtime upgrade.
- No external scanner: this grammar has `EXTERNAL_TOKEN_COUNT 0`, so no
  `scanner.c` was needed (unlike some other grammars in the smacker fork).
